Dear +60102011188,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding dining at Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur.

We would be delighted to arrange a table for you! To ensure we prepare the perfect dining experience, could you kindly share a few details with us:

1. Preferred Restaurant:
   • Merdeka Grill – Prime dry-aged steaks, fresh coastal seafood, charcoal robata grill, and sommelier-curated fine wines.
   • Park Lounge – High-floor panoramic views, signature afternoon tea sets, artisanal pastries, and specialty coffees.
   • Cacao – Artisanal single-origin chocolate confectionery, handcrafted savory bites, and bespoke evening cocktails.

2. Date & Time:
   • What date and preferred seating time would suit you best? (Dinner service is open from 6:00 PM to 10:30 PM).

3. Party Size:
   • How many guests will be dining with you?

4. Special Preferences:
   • Would you prefer a window table, private booth, or quiet corner?
   • Do any guests have dietary restrictions, allergies, or are you celebrating a special occasion?

Menu Highlights:
For your convenience, our curated seasonal menus and chef specialties are available online or upon arrival:
• Merdeka Grill: Australian Wagyu Ribeye M9+, Charred Boston Lobster, Wood-Fired King Salmon.
• Park Lounge: Merdeka High Tea Tower, Truffle Brioche, Classic Scones with Clotted Cream.
• Cacao: Single-Origin Hot Chocolate Flight, Dark Truffle Tasting Platter, Smoked Cacao Old Fashioned.

Simply reply to this email with your preferences, and we will immediately confirm your reservation and secure your table on our calendar!
